title: Implement a Binary Search Tree in Go
description: Build a BST in Go with Insert, Search, InOrder traversal, and Height. Tests are provided via injection.

task_spec.prompt:
Create internal/bst/bst.go implementing a Binary Search Tree (BST).

The package is `bst` and must export:
  func New() *BST                    — create an empty BST
  func (t *BST) Insert(val int)      — insert val; ignore duplicates
  func (t *BST) Search(val int) bool — return true if val is in the tree
  func (t *BST) InOrder() []int      — return all values in ascending order
  func (t *BST) Height() int         — return tree height (0 for empty, 1 for single node)

All 5 tests in internal/bst/bst_test.go must pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: internal/bst/bst.go with BST type and New/Insert/Search/InOrder/Height
Height is 0 for empty tree, 1 for single node
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
